inlines.v: HU'MAN, adjective [Latin humanus; Heb. form, species.] 1. Belonging to man or mankind; pertaining or relating to the race of man; as a human voice; human shape; human nature; human knowledge; human life. 2. Having the qualities of a man. 3. Profane; not sacred or divine; as a human author. [Not in use.]
